hypotheses.text: If Idris Calloway had carried the ball forward instead, the high turnover probability would have fallen and the dangerous interception might have been avoided (reducing turnovers and possibly increasing offensive chance).

If Idris Calloway had passed to Leo Marchetti (CM) instead, the ball would have gone to a different position/player and may have reduced the chance of an immediate interception, altering the turnover/shot probabilities.

If Theo Varga (CM, away) had been 5 m closer to Idris Calloway, increased opponent pressure would have made the interception even more likely, explaining why the pass to H7 was risky and was turned over.
